headline: Origin-confirmed offline recovery and public precache navigation are fully deployed and verified.

items.title: Confirm origin reachability before reopening the offline page
items.insight: An online network adapter no longer triggers a reload until the original route actually answers. Failed or timed-out probes leave the fallback and retry action usable.
items.evidence: 16 focused cases; real origin-down browser proof; production63641742e5

items.title: Use the existing public precache for failed offline navigation
items.insight: A failed public navigation can use its exact page in the current declared precache. Existing runtime freshness and private/member boundaries remain intact.
items.evidence: Service-worker install;1133-path complete production readback; docs/RELEASE_S397.json

followUps: Observe the released offline experience; durable origin-down browser coverage and Pages-observer broker reuse remain future selections.
